title: Website
subtitle: Manage the content of your website here. Changes show on the site within a minute.
keyHint: The site uses this value to know which company it belongs to. Copy it into the settings of the site.

general.title: General info
general.subtitle: The data shown across the whole site: header, contact and footer.
general.name: Name
general.workingHoursPlh:
Monday: 07:00-19:00

Friday: 07:00-19:00

Sunday: closed

featured.title: Featured from our offer
featured.subtitle: The title of the section with drinks on the home page and the drinks it shows.
featured.pickedEmpty: No drink is picked. Pick an even number of drinks (2, 4, 6, 8 or 10).
featured.search: Pick a drink from the list or search for it
featured.pickedRequired: Pick at least one featured drink.
featured.firstDrinks: The first drinks of the menu, type to search
featured.pickedOdd: The number of drinks has to be even (2, 4, 6, 8 or 10) because the site shows them in pairs: add one more or remove one.

image.tooBig: The picture is bigger than {{maxMb}} MB.
image.notImage: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP picture.
image.hintHero: Best: a wide picture of 1920 × 1080 px (16:9), the important part in the middle because it is cropped at the sides on a phone. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {{maxMb}} MB. Saved as an optimized WebP, at most 2000 px.
image.hintStory: Best: a picture of 1200 × 900 px (4:3). JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {{maxMb}} MB. Saved as an optimized WebP, at most 1200 px.
image.hintLogo: Best: a transparent background, about 600 × 200 px. PNG or WebP, up to {{maxMb}} MB. Saved as an optimized WebP, at most 600 px.
image.open: Open the picture in full size
image.hintOg: Best: 1200 × 630 px (ratio 1.91:1), the main content in the middle. JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {{maxMb}} MB. Saved as an optimized WebP.
image.hintInfo: Best: an upright picture of 960 × 1200 px (4:5). JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {{maxMb}} MB. Saved as an optimized WebP, at most 1200 px.
image.mapSubtitle: The Google map loads on the site only after the visitor accepts the cookies. Until then this picture is shown, without it a drawn map.
image.hintMap: E.g. a screenshot of Google Maps with your location, about 1200 × 900 px (4:3). JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {{maxMb}} MB.

contacts.title: Who contacted you
contacts.subtitle: The messages visitors sent through the contact form of the site, newest first.
contacts.name: Name
contacts.empty: Nobody has sent a message yet.

publish.title: Publishing the site
publish.draftText: The site is a draft: visitors see a "coming soon" page and the site is hidden from Google. When you fill in the general info and everything on the published pages you can publish it.
publish.publishedText: The site is published and visible to everyone.
publish.unpublished: The site is a draft again.
publish.complete: Everything is filled in, you can publish the site.
publish.incompletePublished: The site is published, but something is missing:
publish.confirmUnpublishTitle: Take the site back to a draft?
publish.confirmUnpublishMessage: Visitors will see a "coming soon" page instead of the site and Google will not show it until you publish it again.

hero.title: e.g. Welcome to our store
hero.subtitle: e.g. Since 2010
hero.text: A short description of what you do and what a visitor can find with you.

story.title: e.g. About us
story.paragraph1: Introduce yourself: who you are, what you do and what makes you different.
story.paragraph2: Invite visitors to drop by or ask for advice.

seo.title: e.g. Store name | Drinks in Belgrade
seo.description: e.g. A big choice of beer, wine and spirits in Belgrade. See the drinks menu with prices and drop by.

info.title: e.g. Special offer
info.text: A short text about a discount, an event, a service or anything you want to highlight.

seo.title: SEO: Google and sharing
seo.subtitle: This is what Google shows in the search results for this page and what is shown when its link is shared (Viber, WhatsApp, Facebook). Write clearly and include the city and what you do.
seo.ogSubtitle: The picture shown when someone shares the link of your site.
seo.ogSubtitlePage: The picture shown when someone shares the link of this page. Without it, the picture of the home page is used.

typeHints.hero: The first thing a visitor sees at the top: a big title, a text and a button over the background picture.
typeHints.featured: The title of the section with drinks on the home page and the drinks it shows.
typeHints.story: The section that introduces your store: a title, two paragraphs, a button and a picture.
typeHints.info: A section that calls visitors to action (a deal, an event, a service, a message): a title, a text, a button and a picture.
typeHints.text: Free text: headings, bold and italic text, lists, quotes and links. Write here or paste text from another site or Word, the formatting stays.
typeHints.contact: The contact details (phone, Instagram, map) and the contact form, the same as at the bottom of the home page. Nothing to set: the details come from the general data of the site.

section.deleteMessage: The section is deleted from the site together with its picture.
section.deleteShared: The section is on {{count}} pages and will be deleted from all of them, together with its picture.
section.shared: This section is on the pages: {{pages}}. A change shows on all of them.

content.title: Page sections
content.subtitle: Add and arrange the content of the page. Click a section to change its text and picture.
content.removed: The section was removed from the page.
content.existingHint: The same section can be on more pages: a change shows on all of them.
content.empty: The page has no sections yet.

pages.title: Pages
pages.created: The page was created as a draft.

page.title: Page name
page.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. about-us: the page is then at /about-us.
page.systemSlug: The address of the home page and of the drinks menu does not change.
page.publishedText: The page is on the site and in the menu.
page.draftText: The page is a draft: it is not on the site until you publish it.
page.systemStatus: The home page and the drinks menu are always on the site and can not be deleted.
page.unpublished: The page is a draft again.
page.deleteMessage: The page is deleted from the site. Its sections stay and you can add them to another page.
page.inMenu: The page is in the main menu at the top of the site.
page.inFooter: The page is not in the main menu: its link is in the footer of the site (e.g. terms of use).
page.menuFull: The main menu can have at most {{max}} pages. Take one out first. Until then this page is in the footer.
page.menuHome: The logo leads to the home page, so it is not in the menu.
page.menuAdded: The page was added to the main menu.
page.menuRemoved: The page was moved to the footer.

text.label: Text
text.tooLong: The text is too long (at most about 20,000 characters with formatting).
